study: Compiler acquisition before saturation on Omarchy
evidence: Preregistered ten-seed fixed-budget acquisition study; independent of M4 replication
budget_rule: 256 updates and 2048 presentations per method; prefix at 128 updates is secondary; same fixed groups within seed
soft_rule: B is pure temperature-2 teacher KL; hard-answer CE is diagnostic only. This differs from earlier mixed CE/KL KD.
stopping: All 60 models stop at 256 updates before opening test; evaluate 256 primary and saved 128 prefix secondary; no adaptive changes
machine: Omarchy Linux i7-8700K CPU SciPy four threads for every method
